name: Gate Monger
title: Pool Market Monger
examine: Smells of trout and coal dust in defiantly equal measure. Shouts prices at arriving caravans before they've stopped rolling.
lines: Fresh from the Roaring Pool, cold as the falls that filled it!
Fish for the pot, coal for the grate, ore for them as dig. All of it here at the gate.
Caravan's in! Buy now, the prices climb by dusk.
